blocks.text: This bamboo water bottle keeps drinks cold for a full day or hot through the morning so you always have the perfect sip.
Double wall vacuum insulation holds cold drinks for 24 hours.
The same insulation keeps hot drinks ready for 12 hours.
Natural bamboo lid with leak proof silicone seal stays secure.
BPA free 18/8 stainless steel body supports clean taste.
Slim shape fits most car cup holders for easy travel.
Capacity is 500 ml. Double wall vacuum insulation. Natural bamboo lid with leak proof silicone seal. BPA free 18/8 stainless steel body. Fits most car cup holders.
The bottle fits most car cup holders so it rides along easily on commutes and drives.
BPA free 18/8 stainless steel protects water quality and food safety. The leak proof silicone seal stops spills. Vacuum insulation and solid steel construction add durability you can rely on.
Hand wash the lid to keep it fresh. The bottle is covered by a 1 year warranty.
